settings.title:
Sending a unit
to the studio.
settings.sub: Mail-in service works differently from buying a product. These terms cover shipping, condition, approval and turnaround for every unit that comes through The Wig Spa.

settings.title: Ask before you ship.
settings.sub: If you're not certain whether your unit is a candidate for service, send us photos first. We'd rather tell you honestly than have you post it.
settings.fineprint: Most services turn around in 5-7 business days.
